watches.name: TRIEX (STEEL BLUE)
watches.description: SPECS: • CASE DIAMETER: 40.5MM (42mm to the end of the crown guard) • CASE THICKNESS: 11.5MM • CASE LUG-TO-LUG LENGTH: 46.5MM • CASE LUG-TO-LUG WIDTH: 22MM • CASE MATERIAL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM (Bead Blasted Finish) HARDENED TO 1200 VICKERS • CASE BACK: GRADE 2 TITANIUM • CROWN and PUSHERS: 7MM GRADE 2 TITANIUM • BRACELET: 22MM TAPERING TO 20MM AT THE CLASP • BRACELET MATERIAL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM (BEAD BLASTED/HARDENED TO 1200 VICKERS) • BEZEL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM, DIAMOND TEXTURE, 12 HOUR SCALE, 120-CLICK UNIDIRECTIONAL • CASE WEIGHT: 55 GRAMS (ESTIMATE) • BRACELET WEIGHT: 65 GRAMS • BUCKLE: GRADE 2 TITANIUM HARDENED TO 1200 VICKERS WITH ON-THE-FLY QUICK ADJUSTMENT • GLASS: SCRATCH RESISTANT SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL WITH INNER ANTI-REFLECTIVE COATING • DIAL COLOR: STEEL BLUE (MATTE FINISH), DIAMOND TEXTUURE • LUME: SWISS Super-LumiNova (Grade X1) ON INDEXES AND HANDS • WATER RESISTANCE: UP TO 200 METERS OR 660 FEET • MOVEMENT: SWISS MADE 13 Jewels RONDA 5030.D • WARRANTY: 5 YEAR INTERNATIONAL • PACKAGING: VARIUS Watch Company is stepping up to make more conscious decisions that make positive impacts on the environment. We will continue our efforts and promise to do our best to ensure all VARIUS watches and packaging are good for the planet.

watches.name: SEEK (White Dial)
watches.description: The SWISS made SEEK is the perfect combination of classic/contemporary design, built with functionality and reliability that will last a lifetime. CERTIFIED SWISS MADE SPECS: • CASE DIAMETER: 42MM • CASE THICKNESS: 13.4MM • CASE LUG-TO-LUG LENGTH: 48.5MM • CASE LUG-TO-LUG WIDTH: 22MM • CASE MATERIAL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM (BRUSHED SATIN FINISH) • CASE BACK: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH TRANSPARENT MINERAL CRYSTAL • CROWN: 8MM GRADE 2 TITANIUM • BRACELET: 22MM TAPERING TO 20MM AT THE CLASP • BRACELET MATERIAL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM (BRUSHED SATIN FINISH) • BEZEL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH CEREMIC INSERT 120-click unidirectional • CASE WEIGHT: 65 GRAMS • BRACELET WEIGHT: 65 GRAMS • BUCKLE: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH FOLD-OVER SAFETY CLASP AND TWIN PUSH-BUTTON RELEASE • GLASS: SCRATCH RESISTANT SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL (4.5MM THICK) WITH INNER ANTI-REFLECTIVE COATING • DIAL COLOR: WHITE (MATTE FINISH) WITH GLOSSY APPLIED INDEXES • LUME: SWISS Super-LumiNova (BGW9)ON INDEXES AND HANDS • WATER RESISTANCE: UP TO 300 METERS OR 1000 FEET • MOVEMENT: SWISS SELLITA SW200-1 AUTOMATIC • WARRANTY: 5 YEAR INTERNATIONAL • Packaging: VARIUS Watch Company is stepping up to make more conscious decisions that make positive impacts on the environment. All of our watches come with a travel case that was meant to be a travel companion that you take on all of your adventure's. The case was custom designed to hold up to 2 watches and extra straps. We will continue our efforts and promise to do our best to ensure all VARIUS watches and packaging are good for the planet.

specsRaw.CASE BACK: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH TRANSPARENT MINERAL CRYSTAL
specsRaw.BEZEL: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH CEREMIC INSERT 120-click unidirectional
specsRaw.BUCKLE: GRADE 2 TITANIUM WITH FOLD-OVER SAFETY CLASP AND TWIN PUSH-BUTTON RELEASE
specsRaw.GLASS: SCRATCH RESISTANT SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL (4.5MM THICK) WITH INNER ANTI-REFLECTIVE COATING
specsRaw.DIAL COLOR: WHITE (MATTE FINISH) WITH GLOSSY APPLIED INDEXES
specsRaw.Bezel: Made with Swiss precision, the 120 click uniderectional titanium/ceramic bezel has virtually no play. The pip at the 12:00 position is lumed for a more vintage appearance.
specsRaw.Water Resistance: Built with an impressive up to 300 meters or 1,000 feet of water resistance, the Ti-Diver can be worn on any adventure.
specsRaw.Crown: Made from titanium grade 2, the crown is "worthy" at 8mm. It was designed for ease of use, even with gloves on.
specsRaw.Movement: The beating heart of the SEEK is the Swiss made Selitta SW200-1. It features manual winding and hacking capabilities, a 38 hour power reserve, and can produce 28,000 beats per hour (vph).
